This case-insensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/us/vr-common-library/CodeSystem/codesystem-ije-vr defines codes, but no codes are represented here

name: CodeSystemIJEVitalRecords
title: Code System - Placeholder Code System for IJE in Vital Records
description:
IJE Code System Placeholder is needed to provide a URL upon which to anchor concept maps.
This codesystem is only for use in the vital records use cases supported by this Implementation guide, and should not be used elsewhere.
